messages:
rita: Hey team — we need to lock the sequencing for the next model onboarding batch. Two big customer asks: (1) better code generation for internal dev tools, (2) lower hallucination on knowledge-heavy prompts. Thinking we should pick 2 models to onboard in next sprint and a safety/quality gate. quick takes?

dmitri: +1. can we use RICE but cap effort for Dedicated infra changes. customers asking for <200ms p95 latency for short prompts.

anna: Agree. My rough priorities: reach = number of apps using codegen (high), impact = quality improvement on evals (medium-high), effort = infra + eval harness (medium). Confidence low until we run benchmark.

ken: Proposed candidates: 1) Mistral-Code-8B (strong code), 2) Llama3-13B-quant (lower cost), 3) Mosaic-Instruction-7B (safer QA).

rita: Nice. Can we do a quick RICE sketch for Mistral vs Llama3? Put numbers if you have them.

anna: Sure — rough numbers for codegen use case (subject to validation):
```
Mistral-Code-8B: reach=3, impact=4, confidence=0.6, effort=3 -> score ~ (3*4*0.6)/3 = 2.4
Llama3-13B-quant: reach=4, impact=3, confidence=0.5, effort=2 -> score ~ (4*3*0.5)/2 = 3.0
```

ken: Llama3 wins RICE but note it needs quantization tuning to hit latency targets. effort 2 assumes we reuse existing quant profiles; if not, bump effort to 4.

sasha: From safety/evals side: Mistral-Code shows better factuality on our corpus (5% lower hallucination) but worse on long-context API traces. We should include a regression suite: safety set + code-run correctness. Gate: no >2% drop on safety set, and code exec pass rate improved or neutral.

rita: I like gating. Proposed launch criteria (short):
- Eval: code exec pass rate >= baseline +2% or at least within ±1%
- Safety: hallucination delta <= 2% worse
- Perf: p95 latency for 32-token requests <= 200ms hosted, <= 150ms Dedicated
- Cost: token cost delta per 1M tokens <= 20% higher (or justify)

dmitri: Can we add rollout policy: canary 5% traffic, monitor quality metrics for 24h, automatic fallback to previous model if error rate > 1% or avg score drop > 3 pts.

anna: Also add model-variant plan: if Llama3-13B-quant fails latency, fallback candidate = Llama3-7B or Mistral-8B as cheaper variant. We should pre-validate Mistral with a small A/B to speed decisions.

ken: Timeline ask: if we pick two models this week, eng-ml can spin benchmarks in 5 days, infra needs 3 days for capacity reservation if Dedicated. That fits a 2-week sprint if no major surprises.

rita: Sounds good. Two concrete asks for this thread: 1) Vote on pairing (Llama3-13B-quant + Mistral-Code-8B) or (Llama3-13B-quant + Llama3-7B) 2) owners for benchmarks + gating dashboards.

anna: vote: Llama3 + Mistral. owner: I can own benchmarks (run evaluation harness + safety suite).

dmitri: vote: Llama3 + Mistral. owner: I'll own deployment gating + canary automation.

ken: vote: Llama3 + Mistral. I will prepare quant tuning notes and ensure we have fallback configs.

sasha: vote: Llama3 + Mistral. I'll finalize safety regression set and thresholds.

rita: Great — consensus achieved. Next steps:
- anna: run evals (5d) -> post results in #product
- dmitri: reserve infra & set canary rules (3d)
- ken: quant tuning plan (3d)
- sasha: safety thresholds + dashboard (3d)

deploy-bot: note: @dmitri reserved 2 Dedicated slots (gpu-pool-a) for 7 days for "model-onboard-1847654321"

rita: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the evals. If any blocker surfaces, ping me. :rocket:
